chunks: Al-Mufaḍḍal ibn Ṣāliḥ narrated from Abān ibn Taghlib, who said:

I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: "My father عليه السلام used to issue legal rulings during the time of Banī Umayyah that whatever the hawk and the falcon killed was halal, and he was practicing taqiyyah toward them; but I do not practice taqiyyah toward them, and whatever the hawk and the falcon killed is haram."

key_terms.يَتَّقِيهِمْ: he practiced precautionary dissimulation toward them

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on prey killed by a hawk or falcon according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling regarding prey killed by trained birds such as the hawk and falcon. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام explains that his father’s earlier permissive ruling was given under taqiyyah during the rule of Banī Umayyah, while the actual ruling is that such prey is haram.
